mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN area_code IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(area_code) = 10 THEN area_code WHEN sido_code IS NOT NULL AND sido_code != '' THEN sido_code || '00000000' ELSE NULL END AS admm_cd FROM public.sd_area_code WHERE is_active = TRUE AND sido_code IS NOT NULL AND sido_code != '' AND ( level = 'SIDO' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.sd_area_code sido WHERE sido.level = 'SIDO' AND sido.is_active = TRUE AND sido.sido_code = sd_area_code.sido_code ) ) ORDER BY admm_cd

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN sigungu_code IS NOT NULL AND sigungu_code != '' THEN sigungu_code || '00000' ELSE NULL END AS admm_cd FROM public.sd_area_code WHERE is_active = TRUE AND sigungu_code IS NOT NULL AND sigungu_code != '' AND ( level = 'SIGUNGU' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.sd_area_code sigungu WHERE sigungu.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND sigungu.is_active = TRUE AND sigungu.sigungu_code = sd_area_code.sigungu_code ) ) ORDER BY admm_cd

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN area_code IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(area_code) = 10 THEN area_code WHEN eupmyeondong_code IS NOT NULL AND eupmyeondong_code != '' THEN eupmyeondong_code || '00' ELSE NULL END AS admm_cd FROM public.sd_area_code WHERE level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND is_active = TRUE ORDER BY admm_cd

SELECT area_code FROM ( SELECT c.area_code, CASE WHEN c.area_code = #{admmCd} THEN 0 WHEN LENGTH(#{admmCd}) = 2 AND c.level = 'SIDO' AND c.sido_code = #{admmCd} THEN 1 WHEN LENGTH(#{admmCd}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{admmCd}, 3, 8) = '00000000' AND c.level = 'SIDO' AND c.sido_code = SUBSTRING(#{admmCd}, 1, 2) THEN 2 WHEN LENGTH(#{admmCd}) = 5 AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = #{admmCd} THEN 3 WHEN LENGTH(#{admmCd}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{admmCd}, 6, 5) = '00000' AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = SUBSTRING(#{admmCd}, 1, 5) THEN 4 WHEN LENGTH(#{admmCd}) = 8 AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.eupmyeondong_code = #{admmCd} THEN 5 WHEN LENGTH(#{admmCd}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{admmCd}, 9, 2) = '00' AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.eupmyeondong_code = SUBSTRING(#{admmCd}, 1, 8) THEN 6 ELSE 9 END AS match_priority FROM public.sd_area_code c WHERE c.is_active = TRUE AND ( c.area_code = #{admmCd} OR ( LENGTH(#{admmCd}) = 2 AND c.level = 'SIDO' AND c.sido_code = #{admmCd} ) OR ( LENGTH(#{admmCd}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{admmCd}, 3, 8) = '00000000' AND c.level = 'SIDO' AND c.sido_code = SUBSTRING(#{admmCd}, 1, 2) ) OR ( LENGTH(#{admmCd}) = 5 AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = #{admmCd} ) OR ( LENGTH(#{admmCd}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{admmCd}, 6, 5) = '00000' AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = SUBSTRING(#{admmCd}, 1, 5) ) OR ( LENGTH(#{admmCd}) = 8 AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.eupmyeondong_code = #{admmCd} ) OR ( LENGTH(#{admmCd}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{admmCd}, 9, 2) = '00' AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.eupmyeondong_code = SUBSTRING(#{admmCd}, 1, 8) ) ) ) candidates ORDER BY match_priority, area_code LIMIT 1

SELECT c.area_code FROM public.sd_area_code c WHERE c.is_active = TRUE AND c.level = #{areaLevel}
AND LENGTH(#{admmCd}) >= 2 AND c.sido_code = SUBSTRING(#{admmCd}, 1, 2)
AND LENGTH(#{admmCd}) >= 5 AND c.sigungu_code = SUBSTRING(#{admmCd}, 1, 5)
AND ( c.name = #{dongNm} OR c.name = REPLACE(#{dongNm}, '제', '') OR c.name = REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(#{dongNm}, '제', ''), '[0-9]+동$', '동') OR c.name = REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(#{dongNm}, '제', ''), '^(.+?)([0-9]+)가.*동$', '\\1동\\2가') )
ORDER BY
CASE WHEN c.name = #{dongNm} THEN 0 WHEN c.name = REPLACE(#{dongNm}, '제', '') THEN 1 WHEN c.name = REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(#{dongNm}, '제', ''), '[0-9]+동$', '동') THEN 2 WHEN c.name = REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(#{dongNm}, '제', ''), '^(.+?)([0-9]+)가.*동$', '\\1동\\2가') THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
c.area_code LIMIT 1

SELECT c.area_code FROM public.sd_area_code c LEFT JOIN public.sd_area_code sido ON sido.level = 'SIDO' AND sido.is_active = TRUE AND sido.sido_code = c.sido_code LEFT JOIN public.sd_area_code sigungu ON sigungu.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND sigungu.is_active = TRUE AND sigungu.sido_code = c.sido_code AND sigungu.sigungu_code = c.sigungu_code WHERE c.is_active = TRUE AND c.level = #{areaLevel}
AND (sido.name = #{ctpvNm} OR c.name = #{ctpvNm})
AND (sigungu.name = #{sggNm} OR c.name = #{sggNm})
AND ( c.name = #{dongNm} OR c.name = REPLACE(#{dongNm}, '제', '') OR c.name = REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(#{dongNm}, '제', ''), '[0-9]+동$', '동') OR c.name = REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(#{dongNm}, '제', ''), '^(.+?)([0-9]+)가.*동$', '\\1동\\2가') )
ORDER BY
CASE WHEN c.name = #{dongNm} THEN 0 WHEN c.name = REPLACE(#{dongNm}, '제', '') THEN 1 WHEN c.name = REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(#{dongNm}, '제', ''), '[0-9]+동$', '동') THEN 2 WHEN c.name = REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(#{dongNm}, '제', ''), '^(.+?)([0-9]+)가.*동$', '\\1동\\2가') THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
c.area_code LIMIT 1
